scope: Offline-only analytical contract for the Experiment 004 v11 three-way preservation break-even and residual Amdahl analysis.
verdict: The equations and data contracts are ready, but neither preservation parity nor residual hardware headroom may be reported until the optimized-preserve and kill/recompute arms emit complete causal GPU measurements. Frozen v10 values are comparators, not substitutes for those missing observations.

evidence_classes.MEASURED_V10: A value read directly from the frozen, scientifically valid exp004-v10-naive-s41-v7 artifacts.
evidence_classes.DERIVED_FROM_MEASURED_V10: A deterministic arithmetic result whose complete inputs are MEASURED_V10 and whose formula is recorded here.
evidence_classes.LOCALLY_MODELED_V11: An analytical expression, schema, or counterfactual calculated offline. It is not a hardware observation.
evidence_classes.MEASURED_V11: Reserved for a future valid A100 v11 run with source artifact and sample identifiers.
evidence_classes.UNAVAILABLE: Not measured yet; encoded as null and prohibited from final quantitative claims.

measured_v10_inputs.recompute_control_use_restriction: This post-restore correctness oracle submitted eight complete branch histories. It establishes the independent-history token count but is not a measured KILL_AND_RECOMPUTE arm and must not be used as its causal prefill throughput or cost.

shared_prefix_once_recompute_tokens.use_restriction: Counterfactual only. It is not the task-specified independent-prefill kill arm.

v11_measurement_slots.reason: No v11 GPU micro-validation, full integrated optimized run, or measured kill/recompute arm was available during this offline review.

symbols.A: branch age represented by private suffix tokens per branch
symbols.q: logical KV bytes per stored-token equivalent for the exact model, dtype, KV geometry, and runtime
symbols.S: logical state bytes retained by preservation
symbols.m: measured prefix replay multiplicity in the kill arm; task-specified independent recomputation requires m=B
symbols.R: actual recompute tokens emitted by the kill arm
symbols.theta: measured effective kill-arm recompute throughput in tokens/second, computed as R divided by the exclusive recompute-prefill interval
symbols.beta_c: measured effective optimized capture throughput in logical bytes/second over the complete capture-dependent reclamation contribution
symbols.beta_r: measured effective optimized restore throughput in logical bytes/second over the complete restore-dependent resume contribution
symbols.C_p: measured preservation fixed/non-byte time after removing the fitted S/beta_c and S/beta_r terms
symbols.C_k: measured kill fixed/non-token time after removing R/theta, including release and environment reconstruction

state_size_model.justification: The preserved Continuum state stores one shared prefix plus one private suffix per branch.
state_size_model.validity_scope: Use q=57344 only for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct bf16 under the measured vLLM 0.23.0 KV geometry. Re-measure q for another model, dtype, block geometry, compression, or transport schema.

recompute_work_model.fail_closed_rule: Use the measured kill arm's emitted recompute_tokens and record m. Do not infer shared-prefix reuse from preserved-state deduplication. If measured R disagrees with the selected formula, the emitted R is authoritative and the analytical curve must be labeled empirical-token interpolation.

time_objective.optimized_preserve_formula: T_p = C_p + S/beta_c + S/beta_r = C_p + q*alpha_p*(P + B*A)
time_objective.winner_rule: OPTIMIZED_PRESERVE is faster where D_time < 0; KILL_AND_RECOMPUTE is faster where D_time > 0; equality is parity.
time_objective.comparison_window: From the common reclaim trigger through the first resumed rollout token. An intentionally fixed restore hold cancels only if paired runs prove it identical; otherwise retain it in C_p and C_k.
time_objective.common_future_work: Tokens generated after the first resumed token cancel only when branch semantics and remaining work are identical. Lost private rollout work before reclaim never cancels and is reported separately.

closed_form_independent_recompute.threshold_direction_rule: Evaluate D_time immediately on both integer sides of a finite root. Never assume that preservation wins above the root; the coefficient sign determines direction.
closed_form_independent_recompute.degenerate_rule: If a denominator is zero, report ALL_VALUES or NO_VALUES from the remaining constant sign. Never emit an infinite numeric threshold.

closed_form_shared_prefix_once_counterfa.restriction: Report only as a separately labeled counterfactual unless the measured kill arm proves m=1.

gpu_seconds_and_cost_objective.gpu_seconds_definition: Allocated GPU-seconds are the sum of wall occupancy over allocated GPUs for the measured incremental transition. Report device-active GPU time and recompute GPU time separately as subsets; do not add either to allocated GPU-seconds or mix the definitions.
gpu_seconds_and_cost_objective.parity_method: Fit the same affine structure independently to measured GPU-seconds: G_p = Gp_fixed + gp_byte*S and G_k = Gk_fixed + gk_token*R. Solve G_p-G_k=0 with the same root and sign rules.
gpu_seconds_and_cost_objective.fixed_topology_shortcut: Wall-time parity implies allocated-GPU cost parity only when both arms reserve the same GPU count for the same comparison window and no other priced resources differ.
required_outputs: dollar break-even when a measured price exists

fit_and_uncertainty_rules: Rates are effective end-to-end rates from exclusive causal intervals, not theoretical PCIe, HBM, or model throughput.

With only one measured state size, q is exact for that fixture but beta and fixed intercepts are not separately identifiable. Use the measured point directly and label all size curves single-point linear analytical interpolation.

A nonzero fitted intercept requires at least two valid sizes or separately instrumented fixed stages. Otherwise set the intercept to the directly measured non-byte stage sum, not a regression invention.
Prefer paired seed/topology values. If multiple paired runs exist, compute a curve per pair, then report median and observed range; do not pool unpaired stages.
Do not extrapolate across model, dtype, page size, engine version, GPU topology, or a range that changes scheduling/concurrency regime.
Every plotted point carries input artifacts, sample IDs, evidence class, formula version, and whether it is interpolation or extrapolation.

required_paths.end_event: first causally valid SLO restoration marker under the unchanged v10 stability contract

candidate_fused_chains.restriction: Include only v11 operations still causally required before source release. Hash or copy work hidden by overlap contributes only its blocking critical-path portion.

Do not assign chain B to reclamation, useful-capacity, or pre-restore SLO paths when restore occurs after those endpoints. Destination integrity includes only the independent pre-visibility proof that remains in v11.

required_operations: union of every residual v11 state-pipeline operation in chains A and B
other residual state-only orchestration on the selected critical path
candidate_fused_chains.restriction: C is a set union, not A time plus B time plus state total. Each atomic interval appears at most once.

non_overlap_contract.atomic_partition: For each path, sort all measured operation start/end boundaries and partition the path into half-open atomic wall intervals [t_i,t_i+1). Every atomic interval is assigned exactly once to state chain A, state chain B, other residual state, serving/queue dynamics, intentional hold, or other orchestration.
non_overlap_contract.overlap_attribution: If CPU, CUDA, and DMA work overlap, attribute only the operation or dependency chain that controls the measured path's completion in that atomic interval. Retain all resource-active times separately, but never add them to wall time.
non_overlap_contract.shared_timing_rule: A v10/v11 ledger pass that shares one measured interval with other pass records cannot contribute that interval more than once.
non_overlap_contract.set_rule: A, B, and other-state node identifiers must be disjoint. C equals their union. Projections for A, B, and C are independent counterfactuals and are never summed.
conservation_tests: sum atomic wall durations equals the exact path endpoint difference
no two atomic wall intervals overlap
every target node belongs to the selected path
target duration never exceeds baseline path duration
C target set equals the exact union of all residual state sets

projection_algorithm.preferred: Replay the measured dependency DAG. Scale only target-node service durations by factor k, retain dependency edges and non-target durations, and recompute the earliest-start/longest-path makespan. This preserves pipelined overlap.
projection_algorithm.fallback_for_strictly_serial_exclusive_i: T_k = T - X + X/k, where T is baseline path wall time and X is the union duration of the selected target intervals.
projection_algorithm.free_case: T_free = T - X for serial exclusive intervals, or set target-node duration to zero and replay the DAG.
projection_algorithm.rounding: Calculate in integer nanoseconds. Round each scaled node duration once using the report's declared deterministic rule before DAG replay.
projection_algorithm.slo_caveat: The SLO-restoration projection is a mechanical upper bound unless queue/service replay or a paired causal run models the changed enable time. Do not claim that shortening capture shifts TTFT recovery one-for-one.

rules: The >=15% fraction and >=1.20x realistic improvement must refer to an important task-specified path or economically important Helix metric.
A 10x or free projection is an upper-bound sensitivity point, not a realistic hardware claim.
A realistic factor must be justified by measured byte rate, burst rate, state size, latency target, concurrency, stable semantics, placement advantage, and a bandwidth/dataflow-dominated residual.
No hardware-positive result may use v10 removed work, locally projected v11 pass removal, or theoretical bandwidth in place of a measured post-v11 residual.
If the optimized state pipeline is below 10% of important paths, ideal-free speedup is below 1.15x, or kill/recompute dominates nearby regimes, close hardware under the task's ordered gate.

preservation_break_even_by_prefix_length.render_rule: Plot measured points as markers. Connect analytical points only with an explicit 'linear analytical interpolation' label; never apply smoothing.

preservation_break_even_by_branch_count.special_rule: Recompute R for every integer B using the measured prefix replay multiplicity policy. Do not scale from total history tokens while holding logical bytes per history token fixed, because shared-state storage and independent prefix replay scale differently with B.
preservation_break_even_by_branch_count.render_rule: Use discrete integer points/steps. No smoothed branch-count curve.

residual_amdahl_headroom.render_rule: Do not render a v11 series until measured v11 interval/DAG evidence is present. Visually distinguish realistic factor from upper-bound 10x/free sensitivity.

review_findings.finding: The current generic gpu_reclamation_policy.ReclamationWorkload.history_tokens formula is P+B*A. That matches shared-prefix-once replay but not the task-specified independent-prefill kill arm, whose v10 correctness-control token count is B*(P+A)=133120.
review_findings.required_action: For the Experiment 004 v11 economic report, consume the kill arm's emitted recompute_tokens and prefix replay multiplicity. Update or bypass the generic helper before generating branch-count or prefix-length break-even curves; otherwise the baseline case is understated by 114688 prefix-token replays.

review_findings.finding: No v11 or kill-arm causal GPU measurements exist in the reviewed evidence.
review_findings.required_action: Keep break-even roots, optimized timing, residual chain fractions, Amdahl numerical projections, and final hardware classification null until the required valid arms complete.

review_findings.finding: The existing project_amdahl serial formula is valid for an exclusive CriticalPath partition but cannot by itself represent overlap introduced by v11 double buffering.
review_findings.required_action: Use dependency-DAG replay for pipelined v11 chains, or first reduce the trace to a measured non-overlapping blocking partition. Never sum CUDA, DMA, and CPU active times as wall time.

review_findings.finding: A single 16K/fanout-8 measurement cannot identify both fixed intercept and slope for either preservation or recomputation.
review_findings.required_action: Label the required prefix/branch curves as single-point linear analytical interpolation unless additional valid sizes are measured. Do not fabricate confidence bands or smooth curves.
